turns.replyText:
If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
If your order or an item within your order is canceled, you will not be charged. When you place an order, a payment authorization hold is placed on your account for the full amount to verify that funds are available. You are only charged once your order ships.
If you used a debit or check card, the authorization may appear as a pending charge on your statement. These funds are typically released by your bank within 3 to 5 business days, but in some cases, it may take up to 30 days, depending on your financial institution. If you used a credit card, the authorization hold may remain visible for up to 30 days before it is automatically removed.
If you paid with a gift card or digital gift card, a new digital gift card will be issued to you. You will receive an email with a new code within 2 business days of the cancellation.
If you have questions about pending charges or refund timelines, I am happy to provide more information.
